title: SECURITY: Filter private topic metadata from board cards [backport 2026.9]
body:
Backport of #44052 to release/2026.9.

---

## Summary

Both patches harden board-card outputs against topic metadata disclosure to board readers lacking topic-level access. One strips topic identifiers from MessageBus broadcasts, while the other filters restricted tags from the board API serializer.

## Patches

- **Emit metadata-free board_updated signals for topic-card lifecycle events** ([patch #2532](https://patch.discourse.org/patch-triage/2532))
  Board-wide MessageBus card events previously disclosed topic-card identity, placement, and activity metadata to board readers who lacked visibility of the topic's category. The patch now replaces topic-card create, update, move, and delete broadcasts with a metadata-free `board_updated` refresh signal that triggers a refetch through the already-authorized board API. Floater-card events remain unchanged, and the same protection is applied across the shared Publisher path, TopicSync bulk operations, and deletion flows.
- **Board-show API leaks group-restricted tag names on topic cards** ([patch #2544](https://patch.discourse.org/patch-triage/2544))
  The board-show API leaks group-restricted tag names attached to topic cards to anonymous board readers. The response path now preloads a single guardian-filtered map of visible tags across all visible topic and floater cards, and both card serializers consume that map, so restricted tag names are never serialized and tag-visibility queries run once per request instead of once per card.
